reason: Phase 4A proves safe handoff roots and planned row folders, but rows remain claim-disabled. Phase 4B must extend coordinator/worker claim execution without weakening normal queue semantics, source mapping, pending-publish ownership, or destination-policy authority.

notes:
Phase 4B scope: enable additive row claims and worker handoff execution only. Do not apply final destination policy, do not publish, do not mutate PendingServerPush as an accepted result, and do not change normal queue claim/done/release semantics.
D1 distributed unit: row claim. Each claim carries exactly one csv_rerun_row with batch id, row key, source identity, source mapping, and planned handoff folder.
D2 batch authority: coordinator-owned State/Rerun/Network/<batch_id>.json remains batch/row authority; coordinator in-flight state may reference rerun rows but must not replace batch authority.
D3 destination authority: coordinator reducer remains pending. Worker success can only move a row to worker_completed_pending_reduction or equivalent evidence state; final promotion/pending/replacement stays disabled.
D4 handoff contract: workers write only to <NetworkRerunHandoffRoot>/<batch_id>/<row_key>/ after a worker-local create/write/read/delete probe. Remote worker claims require UNC/shared handoff paths. Worker jobs use job-scoped config rewrites for Outsource, LibraryProfiles.output_path, and isolated worker LocalBase.
D5 source mapping: claims must prefer library_id plus relative_path, allow WorkerSourcePathMap fallback only through existing safe path-map code, and reject unstable/traversal source mappings.
D6 lifecycle: stop/claim/release semantics remain coordinator-owned. One worker receives one row; duplicate claims must be prevented across normal queue and CSV rerun rows without changing normal queue semantics. Close-readiness remains unsafe for active/claimable network CSV rerun batches.
D7 result artifact: worker done/result evidence must add rerun batch id, row key, row index, claim id, worker id, coordinator source path, worker source path, planned handoff path, job kind, handoff probe status, and destination_policy_applied=false.
D8 operator surface: no WebView mutation authority. Any UI in later phases must render backend read models only.
Validation rung: network protocol/runtime tests, concurrent claim tests, source path mapping tests, handoff isolation tests, worker result artifact tests, and real-media validation before Phase 4B can be considered complete.
Stop condition check before edits: stop if row execution needs worker write access to source roots, direct final-library mutation, broad SMB write outside NetworkRerunHandoffRoot, unstable source identity, worker-owned PendingServerPush as accepted success, duplicate-claim prevention requiring normal queue semantics changes, reinterpretation of -DryRun, or whole-CSV worker execution.
